_doc: Today's bot (BotInput): always kites, takes BotInput.pick_card_for cards and BotInput.pick_job jobs, no motor noise. One allowed tactic, so the driver asks no tactic decisions; a run plays exactly like scripts/balance.sh's bot policy.
name: sensible
description: A sensible, experienced MapleStory player in a survivor-style round: skills attack automatically while the player moves, dodges and collects EXP.
goals: Survive every boss and clear the stage.
Build up the main attack skills and take new skills that fit the job.
Value survivability when HP is a problem.
